verdict.rationale: Metronome's docs explicitly address revenue recognition, stating it 'stores all of the raw data necessary to manage complex revenue recognition for usage-based business models' with 'daily granularity down to products and revenue categories,' and can export data to a warehouse for custom reporting. However, there is no evidence of pre-built deferred revenue schedules, audit-ready recognition reports, or explicit ASC 606/IFRS 15 compliance framing — it appears to provide raw data rather than finished finance-lead-ready outputs. missing for 10: explicit deferred revenue schedule generation, out-of-the-box audit-ready recognition reports, explicit ASC 606/IFRS 15 compliance documentation, independent/customer corroboration of finance use.
